worker.description: A read-only check used when the main review needs more evidence for a specific concern.
responsibilities: Check only the question assigned by the main review.
Stay within the selected scope and support conclusions with concrete evidence.
Do not modify files or repeat work already completed by the main review.

judge.description: A read-only independent check used only when a serious finding, conflicting evidence, or an uncertain conclusion needs validation.
responsibilities: Confirm or reject disputed findings using concrete evidence.
Check only the claims that need independent validation.
Make sure each retained issue has a safe, practical next step.

extraReviewer.description: A read-only check for a specific concern chosen by the user.
responsibilities: Check the concern requested by the user.
Check only the requested changes and selected files.
Return concrete findings with clear fixes or follow-up steps.

default.name: Code Review Team
default.summary: A deep-review code team with locked logic, performance, security, architecture, and quality-gate roles.

detail.title: Code Review Team
detail.subtitle: Configure the code review team used by Deep Review and /DeepReview. Every reviewer starts on the Fast model unless you change it.
detail.summaryDescription: Parallel reviewers cover the requested scope, then the quality gate consolidates the final result.
detail.membersDescription: Select a member to review its role, responsibilities, model, and strategy override. Locked roles always stay in the team.
detail.localOnlyDescription: Runs inside BitFun as read-only Sub-Agents and reports back into this review thread.
detail.parallelDescription: Logic, performance, security, architecture, and extra reviewers work side by side before the judge validates findings.
detail.warning: Use for higher-risk changes; it can take longer and use more tokens than a standard review.
detail.executionPolicyDescription: Control review depth, timeouts, and how broad scopes split across parallel read-only reviewers.
detail.policySummaryIntro: This live snapshot comes from Review settings and updates when the team policy changes.
detail.policySummaryDescription: {{strategy}} review uses {{reviewerTimeout}} per reviewer, gives the judge {{judgeTimeout}}, splits each role after {{splitThreshold}}, and caps same-role parallelism at {{maxSameRoleInstances}}.
detail.policySummaryAction: Open Review settings to edit the current policy
detail.reviewerTimeoutDescription: Per-reviewer timeout in seconds. Set 0 to let reviewers run without a hard deadline.
detail.judgeTimeoutDescription: Quality-gate timeout in seconds. Set 0 to wait as long as needed for the judge.
detail.fileSplitThresholdDescription: When target files exceed this value, each reviewer role can split into multiple instances. Set 0 to disable splitting.
detail.maxSameRoleInstancesDescription: Maximum parallel instances per reviewer role when file splitting is active.
detail.memberDetailDescription: Each reviewer keeps its own context while the team run is active.
detail.modelDescription: Change the model for this reviewer only. Deep review uses Fast by default, and your update applies immediately.
detail.removeDescription: Remove this extra Sub-Agent from the code review team. Core roles cannot be removed.
detail.addDescription: Bring another read-only Sub-Agent into the deep code review team. The core roles always remain locked in place.
detail.addHint: Only read-only Sub-Agents can join the initial review pass; the quality inspector checks every extra reviewer before final reporting.
detail.emptyCandidates: No additional read-only Sub-Agents are available to add right now.

agentDescriptions.Agentic: Autonomous execution mode: automatically analyze requirements, plan tasks, and execute code changes
agentDescriptions.Cowork: Cowork mode: work alongside you, asking for confirmation at key steps
agentDescriptions.ComputerUse: Computer use mode: capable of operating browsers, desktop apps, and file systems
agentDescriptions.DeepResearch: Deep research agent: conduct systematic investigation and analysis on complex topics
agentDescriptions.Workflow: Multi-agent workflow commander: orchestrate agent sessions through a fractal deployment topology — decompose tasks, create sessions, dispatch via SessionMessage, enforce quality gates
agentDescriptions.Explore: Explore agent: quickly browse the codebase to understand project structure and key files
agentDescriptions.FileFinder: File finder agent: locate relevant files and code snippets based on requirements
agentDescriptions.CodeReview: Code review agent: perform quality checks and provide improvement suggestions
agentDescriptions.DeepReview: Strict Review compatibility agent: runs the highest-strength Review path when historical sessions or commands need it
agentDescriptions.GenerateDoc: Documentation agent: automatically generate code documentation and explanations
agentDescriptions.Init: Init agent: help set up project structure and initial configuration
agentDescriptions.ReviewFixer: Review fixer agent: automatically fix code issues based on review results
agentDescriptions.Multitask: Multitask mode: decompose work into orthogonal branches and use subagents in parallel when beneficial
agentDescriptions.Plan: Plan mode: create detailed task plans and execution steps
agentDescriptions.Debug: Debug mode: systematically diagnose and fix errors in code
agentDescriptions.Claw: Claw mode: extract and integrate information from external sources
agentDescriptions.Team: Team mode: coordinate multiple agents to collaboratively complete complex tasks
